summary: The refresh this subject exists to perform is right. All twelve currency citations are the versions their highest non-CONTESTED COORD recording names over both heading spellings; both moved partitions are stated as g29-leftover-join.v7 and g30-leftover-join.v10 hold them at all six formerly stale class fields; the 46 refresh sites reconcile exactly with an independent sentence-level diff against preview-product-boundary-successor.v10; the doesNot union is the live union of the twelve joins' leftoverDesign arrays, member-for-member and in order; the fourteen classes, seven dispositions and p1p2g3Mapping are unchanged beyond the enumerated refresh; and all 116 recordedInputs digests match live bytes with exact path closure. What fails is the predecessor record again, in the field the last two rejections both named. basedOn.predecessorPinningShape's new gradeRuling clause is false at basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews; basedOn asserts twice, of two different files, that each is the immediate predecessor of this subject; and eight reviewer finding identifiers on disk, three of them from the accepted verdict on the file this successor succeeds, are disposed nowhere.

blockers.finding: The final clause is a universal claim over the verdict objects, conditioned on the verdict file rather than on the object: where a verdict file states a gradeRuling, the object carries it. Two verdict files that state one have objects that do not carry it. docs/coop/artifacts/preview-product-boundary-successor.v9.review-independent.claude2.json carries a top-level gradeRuling with ruling NOT SUSTAINED, and docs/coop/artifacts/preview-product-boundary-successor.v9.review-independent.codex.json carries a top-level gradeRuling with ruling NOT SUSTAINED. basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews.claude and basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews.codex each hold exactly path, sha256 and verdict. blockers.whyThisIsARegression: This is the field CLAUDE-PPBS-V11-SF1 and PPBSV11-B3 both named, and the defect is the same species: predecessorPinningShape is the file's self-description of its own predecessor record, and it again asserts a shape its own objects do not have. CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-ADV-3 asked only that the shape name the gradeRuling member so the sentence would 'describe every field of the objects it covers'; that advisory expressly stood down because 'the shape sentence is not phrased as exhaustive, so nothing is false'. The repair converted a true non-exhaustive sentence into a false universal one. The subject's own disposition of CLAUDE-PPBS-V11-SF1 claims the shape is now 'stated against the objects it covers', and its disposition of CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-ADV-3 claims it 'names the gradeRuling member the verdict objects carry'; two verdict objects do not carry it.
blockers.whyItMatters: The prompt fences 'basedOn.predecessorPinningShape is contradicted by any object it describes' and 'a repair introduced a new defect', and both fire on the same clause. predecessorPinningShape is the one sentence a later SATISFIED-GRADE cycle would rely on instead of walking basedOn object by object; a reader who trusts it concludes that every rejected predecessor's grade ruling is pinned in these bytes, and preview-product-boundary-successor.v9's two NOT SUSTAINED rulings are not.
blockers.repair: Either add gradeRuling 'NOT SUSTAINED' to basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews.claude and basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews.codex, read from the two verdict files, or narrow the clause to the objects that carry the member. Adding the two members is the smaller change and makes the sentence true as written.
